notes.subject: mĩthamiro
notes.rationale: עמוד nĩ kĩng'ang'anjũ kĩa kũmirĩra; 'mĩthamiro' nĩ gũtaũra kwa kĩguni, ti rĩĩtwa rĩa kĩndũ kĩmwe kĩa kĩthĩngũ

notes.subject: kefa
notes.rationale: נחשת nĩ kokothe; 'kefa' kĩgĩkũyũ nĩ kiugo kĩingĩharũrire kwa maũndũ ma meno

notes.subject: mĩhongo ĩha
notes.rationale: Kũana kwa mĩthamiro na matĩĩru — mũcooreri wa maũndũ ma hema

notes.subject: mĩcoteri
notes.rationale: חשוקים nĩ mahuti manjanjũra mĩthamiro; gĩcunjĩ kĩa 'gũcoterera' kĩnyitaga mbere ya mĩhiano ya gũtwa

translation: Na mĩthamiro yayo nĩ mĩhongo ĩha, na matĩĩru macio ĩha, ma kefa; minyoluo ya mĩthamiro na mĩcoteri yacio nĩ thathi.
